The '''Lake of Small Fish''' was the [[lake]] on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]] that flooded the basement of the [[Hand of Thrawn|High Tower]] and almost [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. The small body of [[Water/Legends|water]] was known thusly by the native [[Qom Jha and Qom Qae]].
